title: Fix the attribute listing
prompt: The data catalogue wants a list of every attribute the log lines carry, one row per key, apart from `host`, which every line has. The function below stops with an error. Fix `solve(application_logs)`.
rules: Return one row for each entry in a line's `attributes`: `log_id`, `key` and `value`, in that order.
Leave out entries whose key is `host`. A key stored with no value is kept, with a missing `value`.
A line with an empty map, no map, or only `host` gives no rows. Keep repeated lines.
hints: Read the error message: exploding a map doesn't give one column.
`F.explode` on a map gives two columns, the key and the value, so the alias needs two names.
With `.alias("key", "value")` the filter on `key` works as written.
explanation: `F.explode` on a map gives one row per entry with two columns, the key and the value, so `.alias("attribute")` with one name stops the job before anything runs. Name both: `application_logs.select("log_id", F.explode("attributes").alias("key", "value"))`, then `filter(F.col("key") != "host")`. A line with an empty or missing map has no entries, so it gives no rows without extra code. Don't also filter out missing values: a key that's present with no value is still an attribute the line carries. Reading known keys one by one wouldn't work here, because each service has its own keys.
